## Checklist

- [ ] Created with `npm run new-game` (or follows the same folder layout); only files inside my game folder changed
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] **Winning requires applying the concept.** It cannot be won by random guessing or sliding until it works
- [ ] Wrong answers give feedback that explains *why* (not just "try again")
- [ ] Hints go from gentle nudge to most revealing
- [ ] Numbers are randomised through `ctx.random()` and the physics/maths is covered by tests
- [ ] Units and sig. figs are stated clearly; answers have a sensible tolerance
- [ ] All text and artwork is original (no NCERT text, figures or copyrighted material)
- [ ] Works on a phone-sized screen and with keyboard only
- [ ] I played it through at least once, win and lose paths
